seed_ledger.name: ABI-1 Electric Generating Unit power plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE (supplier probably Energy Transfer Oasis, route not found). Sources: TCEQ permit notice (on-site pressure-drop tap), mgrid.org VoltaGrid article (Oasis firm gas), Cleanview Stargate Frontier report (behind the meter, Oasis), BIC Magazine Hugh Brinson (no Abilene tie). Not reached: FERC, Railroad Commission GIS, county records, Energy Transfer decks. Consolidator: not matched to P8318 Hugh Brinson Abilene Laterals, which serves the Oracle and Crusoe campus at Abilene in Taylor County; this plant is at the Vantage Frontier campus in Shackelford County, and no source ties the two.
